name: swivel
description: Swivel (The Cross-Tab Automator) — turns the browser into an ad-hoc API: extract context from one tab, structure it with Gemini, inject it into another tab's SPA forms.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && npm run build:content
scripts.build:content: vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode target && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode gmail && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode generic
scripts.build:test: npm run clean:test && vite build --outDir dist-test && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode target --outDir dist-test && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode gmail --outDir dist-test && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode generic --outDir dist-test && node tests/patch-test-manifest.mjs
scripts.watch: npm run build && concurrently -n app,target,gmail,generic "vite build --watch" "vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.ts --mode target" "vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.ts --mode gmail" "vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.ts --mode generic"
